stories.title: Consent Core Logic and Tier Transition Engine
stories.description: Implement core consent_service logic governing two-tier HIPAA consent, including tier assignment, transitions (upgrade/downgrade), enforcement decisions (store vs de-identify vs reject), and conversation summarization hooks. Ensure deterministic behavior and audit traceability.

stories.title: Consent Integration with Lead Capture and Debug Logger
stories.description: Integrate consent decisions with lead_service and debug_logger to ensure all persisted data respects consent tier. Enforce de-identification before logging when required and ensure lead creation respects Tier 2 requirements.
